stories.title: How climate change is worsening heat in Europe
stories.summary: Scott Detrow speaks with extreme weather researcher Theodore Keeping about Europe's hottest heatwave. With over 1,000 deaths in France alone, lives depend on the EU's response to rising temperatures.

stories.title: Supreme Court takes sledgehammer to much of federal government's regulatory structure
stories.summary: The Supreme Court struck down most of the limits that Congress and courts had previously established to protect the independence of regulatory agencies that comprise much of the federal government.

stories.title: Mother of murdered sailor demands Navy change how it handles sexual assault cases
stories.summary: The mother of a murdered sailor is demanding the Navy to make long-term changes after her daughter died at the hands of a shipmate.

stories.title: Serena and Venus Williams reunite at Wimbledon
stories.summary: Serena Williams, age 44, is returning to Wimbledon to play both singles and doubles alongside her sister Venus Williams.

stories.title: When resources run thin, volunteer ranchers fight local fires
stories.summary: Rangeland Fire Protection Districts are volunteer groups made up of neighbors who protect their property and nearby land from wildfires, especially when federal and state resources are stretched thin.

stories.title: How a stranger helped a man falling on the subway without damaging his dignity
stories.summary: When Lia Eastep was 21, her father had a stroke which left him unsteady on his feet. His physical limitations almost caused an accident on a subway, but a stranger stepped in.
